description: This file contains the implementation of the SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor class within the Twig templating engine. It performs analysis to determine which parts of a template are safe for rendering, focusing on security and escaping strategies.

classes.name: SafeAnalysisNodeVisitor
classes.description: Implements logic for analyzing and tracking safe expressions within Twig templates for secure rendering. It manages safeness data for nodes, processes various node types, and determines the safety levels for template components.

methods.name: setSafeVars
methods.description: Sets the list of variable names considered safe within the current context.

methods.name: getSafe
methods.description: Retrieves safeness information for a specific node, returning an array of safety tags.

methods.name: setSafe
methods.description: Associates a safeness value with a specific node, storing it internally.

methods.name: enterNode
methods.description: Hook called when entering a node during traversal; here it simply returns the node unchanged.

methods.name: leaveNode
methods.description: Analyzes a node when leaving during traversal, updating safeness data based on node type (constants, blocks, operators, filters, functions, method calls, attribute access).

methods.name: intersectSafe
methods.description: Computes the intersection of two safeness arrays to determine combined safeness.

methods.name: getPriority
methods.description: Returns the priority level of this visitor, used by the traversal system.
